instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova is an Insurtech MGA specializing in underwriting parametric weather insurance for smallholder farmers across Portugal and Spain. Our core product uses satellite data feeds to trigger payouts automatically based on verified climate events like rainfall deficits or frost, providing rapid liquidity to agricultural producers who lack traditional credit access. Currently operating with a lean structure, we manage approximately 5,000 policies, focusing heavily on localized risk management.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm through structured quarterly hackathons and the 'innovation fellow' program aimed at validating high-potential exploratory projects. A key success was a proprietary computer vision prototype developed during the last event, which automated quality inspection for farm inputs, successfully reducing defect escape rates by 35% and demonstrating clear operational ROI.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and evolving climate patterns; therefore, we must identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our strong brand equity in risk management or operational data aggregation. The goal is shifting from purely parametric coverage optimization to diversifying our portfolio into adjacent high-growth sectors like community resilience services.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements in our second-largest market will force us to re-architect our cloud infrastructure within 12 months to maintain operating licenses. This is a non-discretionary technical project that will consume significant engineering capacity, requiring careful sequencing of innovation efforts.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Automated Claims Refinement Engine (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing computer vision capabilities to integrate real-time drone imagery for property damage assessment could further refine our payout trigger accuracy and reduce manual fraud review costs. This builds on proven tech initiatives within the current operations.

first_actions: Allocate 10% of remaining R&D budget to build a pilot module
Identify internal data science resource for model training (contract basis)
resources_needed: 2 months of specialized ML talent contract
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce manual claims review time by 15% within 6 months
milestones: Q3: Pilot module completion and internal testing

opportunities.title: Climate Resilience Tech Partnership (Bold/Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Nova should explore a strategic partnership or acquisition targeting B2B climate resilience consulting firms. This diversification moves the company beyond simple insurance payouts into offering comprehensive risk mitigation services like drought management solutions for agricultural supply chains.

first_actions: Market mapping of 5 potential B2B partners in Spain/Portugal
Develop a white paper outlining 'Parametric Data as Service' proposition
resources_needed: Legal counsel retainer for M&A due diligence (preliminary)
Time allocation from founder to strategic relationship building
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 pilot B2B contract with a recognized climate consultancy
milestones: Q3: Partnership framework established and feasibility study complete

opportunities.title: Localized Policy Micro-Segmentation (Conservative)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of broad expansion, use collected research data to develop highly granular parametric policies tailored specifically for niche crops in specific regional microclimates. This incrementally maximizes coverage efficiency within the existing market.

first_actions: Launch a dedicated 'Micro-Climate Policy' research stream
Define 3 new high-potential insurance niches based on localized data
resources_needed: 2 months of dedicated customer research time
Minor UI/UX updates for policy configuration interface (€1k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average policy coverage utilization rate by 8% in targeted segments
milestones: Q3: Segment definition and model simulation
Q4: Launch of the first micro-segmented product line

next_steps.action: Finalize regulatory pathway and resource requirements for the B2B climate resilience partnership exploration.
Allocate dedicated technical time for cloud infrastructure re-architecture to meet data localization mandates, sequencing innovation around this project.
Establish a small internal steering committee (Founder + 1 external advisor) focused solely on market diversification feasibility studies.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on the founder for all strategic and technical decisions, limiting scaling potential.
Low digital maturity (3) hindering rapid adoption of advanced AI/ML models necessary for true competitive advantage.
High time constraint forcing critical projects (like cloud migration) to divert resources from growth innovation initiatives.
Limited capital reserves making high-risk radical diversification expensive without a proven revenue stream.
